svg.text: A. Pack converter (in the pack head): 4 MPPT bands → 450 V link → dual active bridge → ±500 V
MPPT x 4 bands · droop + current limit · soft start · power-line modem on the bus pins (telemetry, commands)
insulation monitor on the cell strings · series-arc detector · overvoltage clamps · temperatures
enable only when the pilot loop is closed · keep-warm ~5 W from the bus when the array is dark
8 x 8 cm triple junction, 136 per string
diode per string; ~21.3 kW per pack
B. Pack head: front view and side section
1 end tab (into the guide fork) · 2 lifting eye · 3 rescue eye · 4 cone (2) · 5 plug, facing up under the receptacle
6 band harnesses down both edges · 7 converter (~8 kg) on the cold plate
2.0 m wide; panels hang below (30 x 1 m)
Ø8 mm rhodium pins in gold multi-lam sockets: 30 A rated, ~21 A used,
~0.2 mΩ; 40 mm pitch, ribbed PEEK/alumina, ≥25 mm creepage; ~60 N to mate
D. Interlock: the hanger e-fuse is the switch
The bot also commands "pack off" and checks the e-fuse state before touching the lever. Contacts only ever move dead,
so no DC arc can strike in vacuum. Pilot lead 4 mm at the 10 mm/s final creep = 0.4 s of margin.
16 packs ≈ 335 kW at the bus (margin item)
